news.headline: Michael Burry Says He Tried to Warn You About Nvidia, CoreWeave and Nebius. Here's What the 'Big Short' Investor Saw
news.summary: Nebius jumped in Thursday's premarket after Anthropic priced its record $81.3B IPO, then reversed and sank 9.4% to $96.92 as AI-infrastructure stocks sold off, leaving it about 66% below its June peak. Michael Burry's long-running warnings on AI capex and neocloud financing were cited as the bear case gaining traction.

news.headline: Mega Or expands Nebius partnership with two new data centers in Israel
news.summary: Mega Or's data-center arm will supply Nebius with 134MW of IT capacity at Beit Shemesh (under construction) and Masmiya, due by end of Q2 2028 on a seven-year term with a five-year extension option. It is the third Mega Or deal after an 8MW Modi'in lease and an 80MW agreement in January; the shares slipped about 6% as investors focused on the growing capex bill.

news.headline: What's Going On With Nebius Group Stock Wednesday?
news.summary: Nebius gave back early gains and traded roughly flat on Wednesday after its ~11% after-hours jump on Nvidia's results faded. The stock remains far closer to its 52-week low (~$74) than its June high (~$300) following the post-earnings selloff.

news.headline: Why Is Nebius Group Stock Falling Tuesday?
news.summary: Nebius fell about 3% to roughly $104 on Tuesday, extending its post-earnings slide amid a broader tech sell-off. Neocloud names including Nebius then rallied 8-10% after hours on Nvidia's quarterly results.

news.headline: Citi reiterates Buy rating on Nebius after Q3
news.summary: Citi kept its Buy rating on Nebius after the post-earnings sell-off, siding with Rosenblatt against D.A. Davidson's cut. Bulls argue demand is not the problem; the debate is about capex funding and data-center timing.

news.headline: D.A. Davidson Just Cut Its Nebius Target From $250 to $125
news.summary: D.A. Davidson's Gil Luria kept a Neutral rating and halved his target to $125, citing data-center delays and weaker run-rate guidance. Rosenblatt reiterated Buy with a $304 target the same day.

news.headline: Nebius beats Q3 revenue estimates, shares fall as data center delays weigh on 2026 outlook
news.summary: Q3 revenue rose 571% to $980.8M (est. ~$907M) and adjusted EBITDA reached $465.8M, both above consensus. ARR ended September at $6.4B; Nebius now expects to pass $7B in February rather than December and will drop ARR targets from 2027 in favor of revenue, pre-tax earnings and capacity.

catalysts.label: ARR to pass $7B
catalysts.detail: Management now expects annualized run-rate revenue to exceed $7B in February 2027, slipping from the original year-end 2026 target of $7-9B after data-center power delays.

catalysts.label: Q4/FY2026 results and first 2027 targets
catalysts.detail: Expected around February (date not announced). This is the first report under the new framework of revenue, pre-tax earnings and capacity targets instead of ARR; watch delivery against the low end of the $3.0-3.4B FY26 range and the $40-45B 2027 capex plan.

catalysts.label: Meta dedicated capacity ramp
catalysts.detail: The expanded Meta contract (base ~$12B, up to ~$27B) starts delivering dedicated AI compute across multiple sites in early 2027.

catalysts.label: Lappeenranta (Finland) 310MW AI factory first capacity
catalysts.detail: First capacity at the ~$10B multi-building campus is expected to reach customers in 2027.

catalysts.label: NEOM Oxagon capacity (up to 50MW)
catalysts.detail: Phased go-live from Q4 2027 under a preliminary HUMAIN/DataVolt framework; a binding offtake agreement is still pending.

catalysts.label: Israel 134MW Mega Or capacity (Beit Shemesh, Masmiya)
catalysts.detail: Landlord Mega Or targets completion of both sites by end of Q2 2028, adding to the earlier 8MW Modi'in and 80MW Israeli leases.

pulse: Nebius delivered a big Q3 beat on Nov 12 (revenue $981M, +571%; adj. EBITDA $466M), but power delays at a colocation partner pushed the $7B ARR milestone to February, 2026 revenue was steered to the low end of guidance and capex was raised to ~$27B (2027: $40-45B). Nvidia's results (11% after-hours pop on Nov 17) and Anthropic's record IPO (premarket jump on Nov 19) both failed to hold: on Nov 19 the stock fell 9.4% to about $97, roughly 66% below its June peak, as neocloud financing worries resurfaced, even as Nebius signed a third Israeli lease with Mega Or (134MW by mid-2028). The bull case rests on the Microsoft and Meta contracts converting on schedule, while capex intensity, funding and execution timing are the open questions.
